component.name: SilverFast for Linux
component.summary: Run SilverFast 9 with your USB scanner through Wine

description.p: An unofficial community project that runs the Windows build of LaserSoft Imaging's SilverFast 9 scanner software under Wine and connects it to USB scanners on Linux.

On first start it downloads SilverFast 9 from LaserSoft and your scanner's Windows driver from its manufacturer, after you accept their licence terms. A SilverFast licence (MySilverFast account) is required to scan. The Epson Perfection V600 is the reference scanner; others are described in a scanner catalog and can be added as data.
Not affiliated with or endorsed by LaserSoft Imaging or any scanner maker. SilverFast is a trademark of LaserSoft Imaging AG.
First Flatpak build; experimental catalog entries for more Epson scanners.
